title: Order Clerks
description: Receive and process incoming orders for materials, merchandise, classified ads, or services such as repairs, installations, or rental of facilities. Generally receives orders via mail, phone, fax, or other electronic means. Duties include informing customers of receipt, prices, shipping dates, and delays; preparing contracts; and handling complaints.

tasks.text: Review orders for completeness according to reporting procedures and forward incomplete orders for further processing.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transactional data verification is rule-based and reliable

dwas.name: Verify accuracy of financial or transactional data.

tasks.text: Obtain customers' names, addresses, and billing information, product numbers, and specifications of items to be purchased, and enter this information on order forms.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Data gathering aided; verification and consent human

dwas.name: Obtain personal or financial information about customers or applicants.

tasks.text: Recommend merchandise or services that will meet customers' needs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer dialogue needs live presence and adaptation

dwas.name: Discuss goods or services information with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Inspect outgoing work for compliance with customers' specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect inspection of physical items needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect items for damage or defects.

tasks.text: Receive and respond to customer complaints.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Drafting responses easy; live de-escalation is human

dwas.name: Respond to customer problems or complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Check inventory records to determine availability of requested merchandise.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — System inventory monitoring automatable; physical audit human

dwas.name: Monitor inventories of products or materials.

tasks.text: Verify customer and order information for correctness, checking it against previously obtained information as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can cross-check orders; physical verification human

dwas.name: Inspect shipments to ensure correct order fulfillment.

tasks.text: Compute total charges for merchandise or services and shipping charges.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Shipping cost calculation from rates and weights

dwas.name: Calculate shipping costs.
Calculate costs of goods or services.

tasks.text: Inform customers by mail or telephone of order information, such as unit prices, shipping dates, and any anticipated delays.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: File copies of orders received, or post orders on records.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Filing physical documents requires hands in the world

dwas.name: File documents or records.

tasks.text: Notify departments when supplies of specific items are low, or when orders would deplete available supplies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Providing routine information to coworkers is text-based

dwas.name: Provide information to coworkers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Prepare invoices, shipping documents, and contracts.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Compliance docs drafted; human owns regulatory accuracy

dwas.name: Prepare documentation for contracts, transactions, or regulatory compliance.

tasks.text: Confer with production, sales, shipping, warehouse, or common carrier personnel to expedite or trace shipments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Real-time coworker coordination is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Direct specified departments or units to prepare and ship orders to designated locations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Managing clerical staff is supervisory accountability

dwas.name: Manage clerical or administrative activities.

tasks.text: Adjust inventory records to reflect product movement.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain inventory records from provided counts

dwas.name: Maintain inventory records.

tasks.text: Collect payment for merchandise, record transactions, and send items, such as checks or money orders for further processing.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

dwas.name: Send information, materials or documentation.
Collect deposits, payments or fees.

tasks.text: Calculate and compile order-related statistics, and prepare reports for management.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial calculations fully automatable

dwas.name: Calculate financial data.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Compile data or documentation.

tasks.text: Recommend type of packing or labeling needed on order.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Suggests methods; physical constraints need human check

dwas.name: Recommend packing or shipping methods.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Attempt to sell additional merchandise or services to prospective or current customers by telephone or through visits.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional materials drafted; human executes outreach

dwas.name: Promote products, services, or programs.
